digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and author-facing guides
propositions: Authors must name risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after slow codified delivery loops (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) and commit to concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codifying.
Fast proof is either a local run or a manual probe against the real target, and throwaway experiments must be cleaned up with teardown scoped only to resources they created.
The packaged plan guide must identify the new de-risk-before-slow-loop guidance as T15 and remain stack-agnostic without product-specific Terraform or Docker instructions.
The hand-authored overlay enumeration in docs/plan-review-gate.md must be updated from stale T1–T12 to T1–T15 with criterion count aligned to validated registry.
The registry module docstring must reflect the validated 44 criteria / T1–T15 vocabulary, maintaining parity between author-facing docs and implementation authority.
